text:
Evelyn Cho: Quick announce: launching a Voucher Credit program and partner-managed vouchers next quarter. This is a billing product addition (not a unit-price change). :loudspeaker:

Evelyn Cho: TL;DR:
- Voucher credits: one-off voucher codes that apply a token/embedding credit balance to an account when redeemed. Designed for promos, partner deals, and refunds.
- Partner-managed vouchers: partners/resellers can issue vouchers that map to partner ledger accounts; redemptions show partner metadata on invoices.
- Accounting & audit: vouchers are non-refundable promotional value and show as invoice metadata voucher.code + voucher.source.

Ben Marcus: why: partners asked for a lightweight mechanism to give customers bundled credits without going through full billing adjustments. Also useful for refunds and trial top-ups.

Sofia Torres: Support/ops notes: vouchers do not change rate limits or quotas by themselves. They simply add promotional credit balance. If customers hit route caps, normal quota behavior applies.

Ben Marcus: rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (preview, 2 weeks): admin UI + partner API for issuing vouchers (internal only).
- Phase 2 (4 weeks): public redemption API + Console redeem flow, preview invoices with voucher metadata.
- Phase 3 (8 weeks): partner self-service portal and partner invoice passthrough flag.

Riley Quinn: technical: vouchers are represented as voucher objects (id, amount, currency-type=credits, expiry, allowed_routes optional). Redemption is idempotent and logged. We will honor optional route restrictions if set; otherwise credits are pooled into promotional balance.

Evelyn Cho: Finance: vouchers will appear as non-dollar memo line items on invoices: "voucher_applied: CODE123" with metadata voucher.amount and voucher.expiry. No tax effect change expected at launch; Finance to confirm for EMEA.

ops-bot: Automated: feature_flag "billing.vouchers.v1" created in prod, owner=@ben, state=off, auditID=vf-2468001111.

Sofia Torres: Support KB snippets (short):
- "What is a voucher?" -> A voucher is a promo code that, when redeemed, credits your account with usage credits you can spend across supported routes.
- "Will vouchers extend my subscription?" -> No, vouchers add promotional credit only. For subscription extensions contact Sales.
- "Can partners issue vouchers?" -> Yes, partners with the new partner role can issue partner-vouchers that include partner metadata for invoicing.

Ben Marcus: API snippet for redemption: 

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/vouchers/redeem" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"code":"CODE123"}'
```

Response includes: { "redeemed_amount": "5000 credits", "applied_to_balance": "promo" } and invoice preview endpoint will show voucher metadata.

Evelyn Cho: Migration/partner concerns: existing partner credits will not auto-convert to vouchers. Partners who want vouchers should request migration via the Partnerships team; we will support a one-time conversion script.

Riley Quinn: Edge cases:
- Expired vouchers redeem -> API returns 400 with error voucher_expired.
- Partially redeemable vouchers (route-limited) -> remaining balance stays on voucher until expiry.
- Revoked vouchers -> we will void future redemptions; already redeemed credits remain on account.

Sofia Torres: Sales ops: partner vouchers will support partner_id and reseller_reference fields. Partners can request invoice passthrough where voucher usage appears on partner invoices instead of Redwoods.

Evelyn Cho: Action items:
- @ben: enable admin UI for internal issuance (ETA 7 days)
- @riley: implement redemption API + idempotency (ETA 14 days)
- @sofia: partner comms & migration playbook (ETA 10 days)
- @finance: finalize invoice metadata spec and EMEA tax check (ETA 5 days)

Ben Marcus: Telemetry asks: billing.vouchers.issued_count, billing.vouchers.redeemed_count, billing.vouchers.expired_count, billing.vouchers.partner_redemptions. @eng-infra please add.

ops-bot: Automated: job queued voucher-seed-preview job_id=job-2468001122 est=24h.

Evelyn Cho: Support escalation: tag voucher disputes with label billing_voucher_2026Q1 and route to Billing Ops + Finance.

Sofia Torres: Customer-facing copy draft: "Redeem a voucher in Console -> Billing or via API. Vouchers add promotional credits to your account and will appear on your next invoice as voucher_applied:CODE." Will post draft in #marketing later today.

Ben Marcus: Note: Dedicated/Private deployments need partner opt-in for partner-managed vouchers; we'll ship a toggle on the appliance.

Evelyn Cho: Thanks all. We'll run a privacy/data review for partner metadata next week. If anyone has concerns DM me. Closing thread for now.
